carpet-cleaning.tagline: Professional carpet cleaning for homes and businesses in Orange County
carpet-cleaning.description: Our Google Guaranteed technicians deliver thorough carpet cleaning services. We use powerful truck-mounted hot water extraction, proven to remove deep-seated dirt and allergens effectively. This method helps extend the life of your carpets.
paragraphs: Need carpet cleaning in Irvine or anywhere else in Orange County? We have done this work since 2013. We look at your rooms first and tell you the price before we start.
We use truck-mounted hot-water extraction to pull the soil out of the yarn. Your spots and traffic lanes get a pre-spray, then a rinse. The products are EPA Safer Choice.
Little residue is left in your carpet. Most carpets dry in 4 to 8 hours. Kids and pets can go back on it once it is dry.
Call (949) 992-3299. We will tell you the price range and the next opening.
bullets: Use of EPA Safer Choice products

faqs.q: How much does carpet cleaning cost?
faqs.a: Price depends on how many rooms and how soiled the carpet is. We look at the rooms first and give you an itemized quote before any work starts. Call (949) 992-3299 with your room count and we will give you a range on the phone.

faqs.q: How long until I can walk on the carpet?
faqs.a: We pull most of the moisture out with the truck-mounted equipment. Most rooms are dry to the touch in four to eight hours, and we groom the pile and open airflow to speed that up before we go.

faqs.q: Do I need to move furniture before you arrive?
faqs.a: We move the light pieces ourselves and clean around the heavy ones, sliding sofas and tables and setting them back on protective blocks. Clearing small items off the floor before we arrive is all we ask.

faqs.q: Can you get old stains out?
faqs.a: We pre-treat every spot and flush it with truck-mounted hot-water extraction. Some old stains are permanent, and if we think one will not come out we tell you at the walkthrough, before you pay for anything.

air-duct-cleaning.tagline: Improve indoor air quality with professional air duct cleaning services
air-duct-cleaning.description: Our team provides comprehensive air duct cleaning for healthier indoor environments. We use HEPA negative-air machines to remove dust, allergens, and contaminants from your HVAC system. This helps your system operate more efficiently.
paragraphs: If dust keeps blowing out of your registers, call us for air duct cleaning in Irvine or anywhere in Orange County. We have done this work since 2013.
We hook up a HEPA negative-air machine. It pulls dust toward the vacuum so it does not blow through your house. What comes out stays in the machine.
We look at your system first and tell you the price before we start. We can often come the same day or the next when the truck is free.
Call (949) 992-3299 and we will tell you the next opening.

faqs.q: How often should air ducts be cleaned?
faqs.a: For most homes, every three to five years. Sooner if you see dust blowing from the registers, you just finished a renovation, or the home has never had it done. We inspect first, and if your ducts do not need cleaning we tell you that.

faqs.q: How long does air duct cleaning take?
faqs.a: Two to four hours for a typical home, depending on the number of vents and returns. We clean the supply and return runs, the registers, and the main trunk.

faqs.q: Will it make a mess in my house?
faqs.a: No. The system is under negative pressure with HEPA filtration while we work, so the dust goes into our equipment instead of your rooms. We protect the floors and leave the registers wiped down.

faqs.q: How much does it cost?
faqs.a: We quote by the system, counting vents and returns on-site before we start. Call (949) 992-3299 with the number of vents and we will give you a range on the phone.

dryer-vent-cleaning.tagline: Professional dryer vent cleaning for safety and efficiency
dryer-vent-cleaning.description: Protect your home from fire hazards and improve dryer performance with our vent cleaning service. Our technicians remove lint and debris buildup from your dryer ducts. This helps ensure safe and efficient operation of your appliance.
paragraphs: We clean dryer vents in Irvine and across Orange County, and have since 2013. A packed vent is a fire risk, so we clear the line from your dryer to the outside hood.
Lint in the vent is how dryers overheat. We clear the whole run. Then we check that air is leaving at the outside hood.
Do your clothes need two cycles? Does the laundry room smell hot? Those are the signs to call. We will tell you the price before we start.
Call (949) 992-3299. We will tell you the next opening.

faqs.q: How often should a dryer vent be cleaned?
faqs.a: Once a year for most homes. Households that run laundry daily, have pets, or have a long vent run to the roof or a far wall should have it done every six months.

faqs.q: How do I know my dryer vent is clogged?
faqs.a: Towels take two cycles to dry, the dryer and the laundry room get hot, or you smell something burning. Those are the signs we hear before most visits. If any of them sound familiar, call (949) 992-3299 — a packed vent is a fire risk.

faqs.q: Why is not the lint trap enough?
faqs.a: The trap catches only part of the lint. The rest packs into the duct run between the dryer and the outside hood, including bends a brush kit cannot reach. We clean the full run from the drum connection to the exterior hood.

faqs.q: How long does the visit take?
faqs.a: About an hour for most homes. We clean the run, check the airflow at the hood, and show you the lint that came out.

water-damage-restoration.tagline: Emergency water damage restoration services in Orange County
water-damage-restoration.description: When water strikes, our Google Guaranteed team provides immediate water damage restoration. We respond quickly to mitigate damage and begin the drying process. Our goal is to restore your property to its pre-damage condition efficiently.
paragraphs: Got water damage from a leak, a flood, or a burst pipe in Irvine or elsewhere in Orange County? We have done this work since 2013.
We pull the standing water, then set air movers and dehumidifiers. We check the wet spots so your pad is not left damp.
We use EPA Safer Choice products on the surfaces we clean. We will tell you what the dry-out will take before we start.
Call (949) 992-3299 and we will tell you when we can get there.
bullets: Odor and moisture treatment of affected areas

faqs.q: How fast can you get here?
faqs.a: We hold same-day openings for water calls because the first hours decide how much of the floor and drywall can be saved. Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us what is wet.

faqs.q: What do you do when you arrive?
faqs.a: We extract the standing water, take moisture readings in the floor and walls, set drying equipment, and photograph everything as we go so you have documentation for your insurance company.

faqs.q: How long does drying take?
faqs.a: Usually two to three days of equipment run time, depending on how long the water sat and what it soaked into. We come back to re-check readings rather than guessing.

faqs.q: Can my carpet be saved?
faqs.a: Often yes, if we get to it quickly and the water was clean. We tell you at the first visit what can be dried in place and what has to come out, before any demolition.

area-rug-cleaning.tagline: Professional cleaning for area rugs, enhancing their beauty
area-rug-cleaning.description: Our Google Guaranteed technicians specialize in cleaning various types of area rugs. We employ gentle yet effective methods tailored to your rug's specific fibers and dyes. This service helps preserve the beauty and longevity of your rugs.
paragraphs: Need your area rug cleaned in Irvine? We have washed wool and synthetic rugs across Orange County since 2013, fringe included, with a wash matched to the fiber.
Dirt sinks deep into the pile. We take the rug off the floor and pull the dry soil out first. Then we wash and rinse, so no detergent is left in the yarn.
Worried about shrinking? The rug dries flat, so the back keeps its shape. We use EPA Safer Choice products.
If the fringe or an edge is wearing, we can repair it while the rug is in for a wash. You see what the repair costs before we start.
Call (949) 992-3299 for the price and the next opening. We can set a pickup or come look at the rug on site.

faqs.q: Do you pick up rugs?
faqs.a: Yes. We pick up across Orange County, wash the rug at our facility, and bring it back. Smaller or sturdier rugs can sometimes be cleaned at your home — we tell you which makes sense when you call (949) 992-3299.

faqs.q: How much does rug cleaning cost?
faqs.a: By the rug's size and fiber. Wool and delicate fibers take more careful handling than synthetics. We confirm the price before any cleaning starts.

faqs.q: Is it safe for wool and delicate rugs?
faqs.a: We identify the fiber and test the dyes before anything touches the rug, then wash to match what it is made of. If a rug is too fragile to clean safely, we say so instead of risking it.

faqs.q: How long until I get my rug back?
faqs.a: We give you the turnaround when we quote the job — it depends on the fiber and how long the rug needs to dry flat. On-site cleanings dry the same day.

oriental-rug-cleaning.tagline: Specialized cleaning for delicate Oriental and Persian rugs
oriental-rug-cleaning.description: Trust our Google Guaranteed specialists with your valuable Oriental and Persian rugs. We use a meticulous, hand-washing approach suitable for their intricate designs and dyes. This preserves their unique artistry and extends their life.
paragraphs: Have an Oriental or Persian rug that needs cleaning in Orange County? Since 2013, we have checked the dyes and the foundation before any water touches the rug.
We take the dry soil out first. The wash is slow, with EPA Safer Choice products. The rinse has to be complete, or the dirt comes back.
Silk and older wool need that slower wash so the color stays put. If a rug should not be washed, we will tell you.
Call (949) 992-3299. We will look at the rug before we quote it and give you the next opening.

faqs.q: Is it safe to wash a handmade Oriental rug?
faqs.a: Yes, when the wash matches the rug. We test every dye before water touches it, wash by hand, and control the drying so the foundation stays straight. Machine-era shortcuts are what damage these rugs, and we do not use them.

faqs.q: My rug is old or valuable. Will you still clean it?
faqs.a: We inspect it first and tell you honestly what cleaning can and cannot do. If we think a rug is too fragile or the dyes are unstable, we say so before taking the job.

faqs.q: Something spilled on my Oriental rug. What now?
faqs.a: Do not scrub it — that spreads the spill and breaks the pile. Soak up what you can with a dry white towel and call (949) 992-3299. The sooner we wash it, the better the odds it comes out completely.

faqs.q: Do you repair fringe and edges?
faqs.a: Yes. We also do area rug repair, so worn fringe, unraveling edges, and small holes can be handled in the same visit as the cleaning.

rug-pickup.tagline: Convenient rug cleaning with pickup and delivery across Orange County.

faqs.q: Is your cleaning safe for my fabric?
faqs.a: We check the manufacturer's care code on every piece and test a hidden area before cleaning. The method changes with the fabric — what works on a synthetic weave is wrong for silk or a loose linen.

faqs.q: How long does upholstery take to dry?
faqs.a: A few hours for most pieces. We extract as much moisture as the fabric allows and leave cushions positioned to finish drying evenly.

faqs.q: How long until I can sit on it?

faqs.a: No. We check the manufacturer's code first. Some fabrics take hot-water extraction, others need a low-moisture method. Picking the wrong one is how couches get ruined, so we match the method to the piece.

leather-furniture-cleaning.tagline: Specialized cleaning for leather furniture, preserving its elegance.

faqs.q: Can you fix dry or cracking leather?

faqs.q: How often should leather furniture be serviced?
faqs.a: A professional clean and condition every six to twelve months keeps the leather from drying out, especially here where the sun is on it most of the year.

microfiber-couch-cleaning.tagline: Expert microfiber couch cleaning for a fresh and clean look.
microfiber-couch-cleaning.description:
We specialize in cleaning microfiber couches, tackling common stains and dirt effectively. Our methods are designed to preserve the unique texture of microfiber.
Restore your microfiber furniture to its original condition with our professional service.
paragraphs: Cleaning a microfiber couch in Orange County takes its own method, or it can watermark. Tell us your couch is microfiber when you call.
We test a small spot first. Then we clean with EPA Safer Choice products and extract so the nap stays even.
Your kids and pets can use the couch again once it is dry. We look at it before we give you a price.
Call (949) 992-3299 and we will tell you the next opening.

faqs.q: What makes microfiber different to clean?
faqs.a: The care code decides everything — some microfiber takes water, some only takes solvent, and using the wrong one leaves rings and stiff patches. We check the code and match the method to it.

faqs.q: Will cleaning leave water spots?
faqs.a: No. Water spots come from soaking the fabric. We use controlled moisture and even strokes so the couch dries uniformly, then brush the nap back up as it dries.

faqs.q: How long does a microfiber couch take to dry?
faqs.a: A few hours. We set the cushions to dry evenly and the nap is restored before we leave.

hardwood-floor-cleaning.tagline: Professional hardwood floor cleaning, enhancing natural beauty.
hardwood-floor-cleaning.description:
Our hardwood floor cleaning service removes dirt and grime without damaging your floor's finish. We use specialized equipment and cleaning agents for effective results.
Bring back the natural shine and cleanliness of your hardwood floors.

If your finish is already worn through, we will tell you before we start. We are Google Guaranteed.
Call (949) 992-3299. We will look at your floor before we give you a price.

faqs.q: How long does hardwood floor cleaning take?
faqs.a: Most homes take one to two hours, depending on the area and the buildup. The floor is dry enough to walk on almost right away.

faqs.q: Will the cleaning harm the finish?
faqs.a: No. We clean with a light mix and a machine made for sealed wood. We do not flood the boards and we do not strip the finish. If the finish is already worn through in a walking lane, we point it out before we start.

faqs.q: How much does hardwood floor cleaning cost?

tile-and-grout-cleaning.tagline: Professional tile and grout cleaning for a cleaner, healthier home.
tile-and-grout-cleaning.description: Restore the shine to your tile and grout. Our specialized cleaning process removes embedded dirt and grime, revitalizing your floors. We serve homes and businesses throughout Orange County, CA, since 2013.
paragraphs: We do tile and grout cleaning in Orange County kitchens, baths, and entries. Ceramic, porcelain, and stone. If your grout lines look dark, that is grease sitting down in the grout, and that is what we pull out.
First, a pre-spray loosens the soil. Then hot water and extraction pull it out of the lines. If you want, we can seal the grout after.
We use EPA Safer Choice products. We have cleaned floors in Orange County since 2013.
Call (949) 992-3299 for the price and the next opening. We come the same day or the next when the truck is free.
bullets: Pre-treatment of all tile and grout
Thorough extraction of dirt and water

faqs.q: How do you clean grout?
faqs.a: We spray an alkaline pre-treatment into the grout lines, machine-scrub them, then rinse with hot water under pressure while extracting at the same time. The soil leaves with the rinse water instead of being pushed around with a mop.

faqs.q: Can you seal the grout afterward?
faqs.a: Yes, and right after cleaning is the best time, while the lines are clean and open. Sealed grout stays cleaner longer and wipes up instead of absorbing the next spill.

faqs.q: Will the equipment damage my tile?
faqs.a: No. We match the products and the pressure to the surface — ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone each get set up differently. Stone never gets acidic products from us.

faqs.q: How much does it cost?
faqs.a: By the square footage and the condition of the grout. Call (949) 992-3299 with the rooms you want done and we will give you a range, then confirm it on-site before we start.

vinyl-floor-cleaning.tagline: Expert vinyl floor cleaning to maintain durability and appearance.
vinyl-floor-cleaning.description: Keep your vinyl floors looking new with our professional cleaning services. We remove scuffs, dirt, and dullness, extending the life of your flooring. Our team has served Orange County, CA, since 2013.

We scrub the dirt loose and rinse it off. Sheet vinyl in a busy kitchen gets the same care.
We use EPA Safer Choice products. We look at your floor first and tell you the price before we start.
Call (949) 992-3299 for the price and the next opening.

faqs.q: What do you do that mopping does not?
faqs.a: A mop slides over the texture of vinyl and leaves the soil in the low spots. We machine-scrub with a cleaner matched to the floor and extract the soil out, so the texture comes clean instead of just the high points.

faqs.q: Is your process safe for vinyl plank?
faqs.a: Yes. We use controlled moisture and pick it back up as we go, and we never use steam on vinyl — heat is what warps planks and breaks down the adhesive.

faqs.q: How long before I can walk on the floor?
faqs.a: Right away for socks and clean shoes. The floor is dry within the hour.

natural-stone-cleaning.tagline: Specialized natural stone cleaning for lasting beauty and protection.
natural-stone-cleaning.description: Preserve the elegance of your natural stone surfaces with our expert cleaning. We gently remove impurities, enhancing their natural beauty. Serving Orange County, CA, since 2013, we deliver quality results.
paragraphs: We do natural stone cleaning in Orange County on marble, travertine, and granite, both floors and counters. Your stone can etch, so we clean it in a way that does not etch the surface.

Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us what stone you have. We will give you the price and the next opening.

faqs.q: How do you clean natural stone?
faqs.a: With pH-neutral products matched to the stone and machine agitation, then a controlled rinse. Acids etch marble, travertine, and limestone permanently, so nothing acidic ever touches your stone on our jobs.

faqs.q: Can you fix dull spots and etching?
faqs.a: Cleaning removes soil and buildup, which handles most dullness. Etching is physical damage to the surface, and we tell you at the walkthrough which spots cleaning will fix and which need refinishing.

faqs.q: Should the stone be sealed?
faqs.a: Most natural stone should be, especially in kitchens, showers, and entries. We seal right after cleaning, while the stone is clean and open, and tell you how long that seal should last in your spot.

pet-stain-odor.tagline: Effective pet stain and odor removal for fresh, clean carpets.
pet-stain-odor.description: Eliminate pet stains and odors from your carpets with our specialized treatment. We target the source of the problem, leaving your home fresh. Serving Orange County, CA, since 2013, we restore your peace of mind.
paragraphs: We do pet stain and odor removal for Orange County carpet. That covers the stain you can see and the smell that stayed in the pad. If the urine reached the pad, that is a different job from a surface spill.
We treat the yarn with an enzyme, then flush it with truck-mounted hot-water extraction. If the pad is holding the accident, we will tell you.
We use EPA Safer Choice products. The sooner it is treated, the less chance the smell stays.
Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us how old the spot is. We will give you the price before we start.
bullets: UV light inspection for hidden spots

faqs.q: Can you get pet urine smell out of carpet?
faqs.a: If the urine stayed in the yarn, yes — we treat it with an enzyme and flush it with truck-mounted hot-water extraction. If it soaked into the pad, that is a bigger job, and we tell you which one you have after we inspect with UV light.

faqs.q: What should I do before you arrive?
faqs.a: Soak up fresh accidents with a dry towel and leave the spot alone — scrubbing and store chemicals can set the stain and make our job harder. Then call (949) 992-3299 and tell us how old the spots are.

faqs.q: Can you find spots I cannot see?
faqs.a: Yes. Urine that dried weeks ago is invisible in daylight but shows under UV light. We walk the room with it so the treatment covers every spot, not just the ones you knew about.

faqs.q: Will the stain come back?
faqs.a: A spot that reappears days after cleaning usually means the pad underneath is still holding urine. That is exactly what our inspection is for — we tell you up front whether the pad is involved, before you pay for a surface treatment that will not hold.

faqs.q: What kinds of businesses do you serve?
faqs.a: Offices, retail, restaurants, gyms, medical suites, and property managers across Orange County. Carpet, air ducts, tile, and upholstery under one visit when you want it that way.

faqs.q: Do you offer recurring service?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of our commercial accounts are on a schedule — monthly, quarterly, or seasonal — and recurring service is priced lower than one-off calls.

faqs.q: How do we get a quote?
faqs.a: Call (949) 992-3299 and we set up a walk-through. You get an itemized quote for exactly the areas you want covered, before anything is scheduled.

car-seat-cleaning.tagline: Restore car seat freshness with professional cleaning in Orange County.
car-seat-cleaning.description: Refresh your vehicle's interior with our specialized car seat cleaning service. We address spills, stains, and odors, bringing new life to your car's upholstery.
paragraphs: Your vacuum leaves dirt in the seams of your seats. We do car seat cleaning for cars, trucks, and RVs across Irvine and Orange County, and we lift out that dirt.
We check the seat material first. The products are EPA Safer Choice, so your kids and pets can ride once the seat is dry.
We have been doing this across Orange County since 2013. We are Google Guaranteed.
Call (949) 992-3299 for the price and the next opening. We can come the same day or the next when the truck is free.

faqs.q: Do you come to me?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean car seats and interiors at your home or workplace in Orange County. Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us what you drive and what happened to it.

faqs.q: Can you clean leather seats too?
faqs.a: Yes. Fabric seats get extraction cleaning, leather gets a leather-specific cleaner and conditioner. We check what you have and use the right process for each surface.

faqs.q: How long does it take?
faqs.a: One to two hours for seats, longer for a full interior. The seats are dry enough to drive on within a few hours.

drape-cleaning.tagline: Professional drape cleaning for homes and businesses in Orange County.
drape-cleaning.description: Revitalize your drapes with our expert cleaning service, removing accumulated dust, allergens, and odors. We help maintain the appearance and extend the life of your window treatments.
paragraphs: We clean drapes in Orange County homes right where they hang, so you don't have to take them down. We remove the dust and the film that builds up on the window side.
Fabrics that need dry cleaning are the exception. Those we take down, send out, and hang back up when they come back, so you never touch a ladder.
We check the fabric first and give you the price before we start. Our products are EPA Safer Choice.
We have cleaned drapes here since 2013. We are Google Guaranteed.
Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us how many panels. We can come the same day or the next when the truck is free.

faqs.q: Do you take the drapes down?
faqs.a: When the job calls for it, yes — we take them down, clean them, and rehang them. Many drapes can also be cleaned in place. We tell you which your fabric needs after we look at it.

faqs.q: Is it safe for delicate fabric?
faqs.a: We check the fabric and lining first and match the method to it. Silk, lined panels, and anything with embellishments get handled differently than everyday polyester.

faqs.q: How do you price drape cleaning?
faqs.a: By the panel, counting size and fabric. Call (949) 992-3299 with how many windows you have and we will give you a range on the phone.

outdoor-furniture-cleaning.tagline: Restore outdoor furniture with professional cleaning in Orange County.
outdoor-furniture-cleaning.description: Refresh your outdoor living spaces with our dedicated outdoor furniture cleaning service. We remove dirt, mildew, and environmental buildup, making your patio furniture look new again.
paragraphs: We clean patio cushions and the frames they sit on for Orange County homes. Sun and salt air build up on them, and we clean that off.
We wash the cover, not the foam, so your cushion doesn't stay wet. Frames get their own pass so the finish isn't scratched off.
Our products are EPA Safer Choice. We have done this work since 2013.
Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us how many cushions. We'll give you the price and the next opening.

faqs.q: What outdoor furniture do you clean?
faqs.a: Cushions, slings, frames, and umbrellas — full patio sets. Sun, dust, and marine air build up a film that a hose does not touch, and that is what we remove.

faqs.q: Can you get mold and mildew off cushions?
faqs.a: Yes. We treat the growth, extract it out of the fabric, and the cushions dry outside the same day. If fabric is too far gone to save, we say so instead of charging you to clean it.

faqs.q: When should I book?
faqs.a: Before you need the patio — spring and ahead of holidays book up first. Call (949) 992-3299 with the size of your set and we will quote it.

encapsulation-carpet-cleaning.tagline: Low-moisture encapsulation for quick-drying carpet cleaning.
encapsulation-carpet-cleaning.description: Our encapsulation carpet cleaning offers a low-moisture alternative for a quick-drying and effective clean. This method is suitable for commercial spaces and residential areas requiring fast turnaround.
paragraphs: Encapsulation carpet cleaning in Orange County is the faster clean for a maintenance visit. The solution crystallizes around the soil, and then it vacuums up.
It dries quicker than hot-water extraction. That suits a busy office, or a room you need back the same day.
It is not the deep clean. If soil is packed into the yarn, we use truck-mounted hot-water extraction. We will tell you which one you need.
We have offered this since 2013. Call (949) 992-3299 for the price and the next opening.
keywords: low moisture carpet cleaning orange county

faqs.q: What is encapsulation cleaning?
faqs.a: A low-moisture method where the cleaning agent crystallizes around the soil and comes out with normal vacuuming. The carpet is dry in about an hour, which is why offices and busy households book it.

faqs.q: Is it better than steam cleaning?
faqs.a: They solve different problems. Encapsulation is fast-drying maintenance between deep cleans. Truck-mounted hot-water extraction is the deep clean. We recommend one after seeing the carpet, and sometimes the honest answer is both on a rotation.

faqs.q: How fast can the area be used again?
faqs.a: About an hour. That makes it the method we bring when a lobby, office, or hallway cannot be out of service for an afternoon.

emergency-cleaning.tagline: Rapid response for unexpected cleaning needs in Orange County.
emergency-cleaning.description: When unexpected spills or situations arise, our emergency cleaning service provides quick and effective solutions. We are prepared to address urgent cleaning needs to mitigate damage.
paragraphs: If an overflow, a backup, or storm water gets into your Orange County home, our emergency cleaning gets the water out. Call and we will tell you the next time we can be there.
We pull the water and start the dry-out. We tell you what it will take before we start.
We have done this work since 2013. We are Google Guaranteed.
Call (949) 992-3299. We come the same day or the next when the truck is free. We do not promise a middle-of-the-night arrival.

faqs.q: How fast can you get here?
faqs.a: We hold same-day openings for emergencies — flooding, a big spill before guests arrive, a pet accident that cannot wait. Call (949) 992-3299 and we will tell you the next opening honestly.

faqs.q: What counts as an emergency job?
faqs.a: Water on the floor, a spill setting into carpet or upholstery, or a mess that has to be gone before an event. If it is getting worse by the hour, call — waiting is what turns small jobs into big ones.

faqs.q: Does emergency service cost extra?
faqs.a: You get the price before we start, the same as any job. The quote is itemized on-site, so there is no surprise on the invoice.

floor-cleaning.tagline: Professional floor cleaning services for a healthier, cleaner home.
floor-cleaning.description: Our floor cleaning process removes deep-seated dirt and allergens from various surfaces. We restore the appearance of your floors, leaving them fresh and revitalized. This service is designed for homeowners and businesses across Orange County.
paragraphs: Need your tile, grout, vinyl, or hardwood floors cleaned in Irvine? We look at the floor first and give you the price before we start.
Each surface gets its own mix. Tile and grout can take a hotter rinse. Vinyl and hardwood get a lighter touch, so the wear layer and the finish stay put.
We use EPA Safer Choice products. We are Google Guaranteed and have worked in Irvine since 2013.
Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us your floor type. We will give you the price and the next opening. That can be the same day or the next when the truck is free.
bullets: Application of EPA Safer Choice cleaning solutions

faqs.q: Which floors do you clean?
faqs.a: Hardwood, tile and grout, vinyl, laminate, and natural stone. Each gets its own products and equipment — the setup that cleans grout lines would be wrong on a sealed wood floor.

faqs.q: How do you decide the method?
faqs.a: We look at the floor first. The material, the finish, and the condition decide the products, the moisture level, and the machine. Then we quote the job before any work starts.

faqs.q: How much does floor cleaning cost?
faqs.a: By square footage and floor type. Call (949) 992-3299 with the rooms and what the floor is made of, and we will give you a range on the phone.

coffee-and-wine-stain-removal.tagline: Coffee and wine stain removal for Orange County homes.
paragraphs: A coffee or wine spill does not have to stay in your carpet. We treat the spot, rinse it with hot-water extraction, and pull the stain out to the truck instead of rubbing it deeper in.

What came out of the cup matters less than what happened after. A spot that was scrubbed with a store product or hit with the wrong cleaner can set. We look at the stain first and tell you honestly what will lift and what has already dyed the fiber.

Red wine, coffee with cream, and tea each get a different treatment. We test a small area, treat the spot, then rinse so no sticky residue is left to catch new dirt. The same work handles rugs and upholstery fabric.
You get the price before we start. If a stain will not come out all the way, we say so before any work begins, not after.
The sooner we get to a spill, the better the odds. Blot it with a dry white towel, skip the scrubbing, and call (949) 992-3299. We hold same-day and next-day openings across Irvine and Orange County.

faqs.q: Can you get red wine out of carpet?
faqs.a: Often yes, especially when the spill is fresh and has not been scrubbed with a store product. We look at the spot first and tell you before we start how much will lift.

faqs.q: What should I do right after a spill?
faqs.a: Blot with a dry white towel from the outside of the spot toward the middle. Do not scrub and do not use hot water. Then call (949) 992-3299 and we will tell you the next opening.

faqs.q: Does stain removal cost extra on top of carpet cleaning?
faqs.a: Spot treatment for a few spills is usually part of the carpet cleaning price. A large or set stain can take extra work, and we price that on-site before we start.

carpet-protection.tagline: Protective treatment after carpet cleaning in Orange County.
paragraphs: After we clean your carpet, we can apply a protective treatment while the fiber is still open. The treatment coats the fiber so the next spill beads up and blots away instead of soaking straight in.

Protection does not make carpet stain-proof. It buys you time. A glass of juice that would have soaked in within seconds sits on the surface long enough to grab a towel. Vacuuming also pulls dry soil out more easily because the dirt grips the fiber less.

New carpet comes with a factory treatment that wears off in the walking lanes after a few years of traffic and cleanings. Applying protection after a deep clean puts that layer back where it wears first: hallways, stairs, and the path around the couch.
We quote the protection with the cleaning so you see the whole price before we start. It adds a little drying time, and the carpet is ready to walk on the same day.
If you are already booking a carpet cleaning, ask about adding protection to the rooms that get the most traffic. Call (949) 992-3299 and we will price both together on the phone.

faqs.q: Does the protective treatment make carpet stain-proof?
faqs.a: No, and we will not tell you it does. It slows a spill down so you can blot it up before it soaks in, and it helps vacuuming pull out dry soil.

faqs.q: How long does carpet protection last?
faqs.a: It wears off with foot traffic, fastest in hallways and on stairs. Most homes reapply it with each deep cleaning to keep the walking lanes covered.

faqs.q: Can I walk on the carpet after the treatment?
faqs.a: Yes. The carpet needs the usual 4 to 8 hours to dry after cleaning and protection together, and socks are fine while it finishes drying.

laminate-floor-cleaning.tagline: Laminate floor cleaning for Orange County homes.
paragraphs: Laminate looks like wood, but it cleans differently. The boards are a picture layer over a pressed core, and that core swells if water sits in the seams. So we clean laminate with a machine scrub and a light mix, and we do not flood the floor.

The gray film that builds up on laminate is usually residue from string mops and store cleaners. Each mopping leaves a little more behind, and the film catches dirt. We scrub that film off and lift the dirt away instead of pushing it around.
We do not wax or polish laminate. Coatings sit on top of the picture layer, look cloudy, and peel. What a laminate floor needs is the buildup removed so the finish underneath can show again.
You get the price before we start, based on the area and how much buildup is on the floor. The floor is dry enough to walk on almost right away.
If some rooms are laminate and others are tile or wood, we clean each one the way that floor needs on the same visit. Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us roughly how many rooms.

faqs.q: Why does my laminate floor look cloudy?
faqs.a: Usually it is a film left by mopping products, not damage. Each pass leaves a thin layer that catches dirt. A machine scrub removes the film without soaking the seams.

faqs.q: Do you polish laminate floors?
faqs.a: No. Polish and wax do not bond to laminate. They look cloudy and peel. We remove buildup so the original finish shows, and we skip coatings that do not belong on this floor.

faqs.q: Will water damage my laminate during cleaning?
faqs.a: We use a light mix and pick the moisture back up as we go, so water does not sit in the seams. That is the main thing that separates this from mopping.

area-rug-repair.tagline: Area rug repair alongside cleaning in Orange County.
paragraphs: A good rug does not have to be replaced because the edge is fraying or the fringe is worn. We repair fringe, edges, and binding on area rugs, usually together with a wash.

Fringe wears first because vacuums catch it and feet drag it. Worn fringe can be secured, rebuilt, or removed cleanly, depending on the rug and what you want it to look like. An unraveling edge gets rebound before the wear spreads into the field of the rug.

We look at the rug first and tell you what the repair involves and what it costs before any work starts. On some rugs a repair is simple. On others, especially hand-knotted pieces, we tell you honestly whether the repair is worth it against the value of the rug.
Most repairs happen at our facility. We pick the rug up, wash it, make the repair, and bring it back. Pickup and delivery work the same way as our regular rug service.
If a rug you like is starting to fray, call (949) 992-3299. Send a photo of the damage if you can, and we will tell you what is possible before we come out.

faqs.q: Can worn fringe be fixed?
faqs.a: Yes. Depending on the rug, fringe can be secured so it stops unraveling, rebuilt, or removed cleanly with the end bound. We show you the options and the price before we start.

faqs.q: Is repair worth it on my rug?
faqs.a: We tell you honestly. On a machine-made rug a big repair may cost more than the rug is worth, and we say so. On wool and hand-knotted rugs a repair usually protects what the rug is worth.

faqs.q: Do you repair rugs in the home?
faqs.a: Most repairs happen at our facility together with a wash. We pick the rug up and bring it back. Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us what the damage looks like.

drape-pickup.tagline: Drape pickup and dry cleaning in Orange County.
paragraphs: Most drapes we clean right where they hang. But some fabrics should not be wet cleaned at all: lined silk, some older weaves, and panels with water stains that need a solvent process. Those we take down, send through dry cleaning, and hang back up.
You do not climb a ladder at any point. We take the panels down, note how each one hangs, and rehang them the same way when they come back.

We tell you which process your drapes need when we see the fabric. If they can be cleaned in place, that is faster and costs less, and we say so. Pickup and dry cleaning is for the fabrics that truly need it.
The price covers take-down, cleaning, and rehanging, and you get it before we start. Most drapes are back on the window within the week.
Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us what the drapes are made of if you know, or send a photo. We will tell you on the phone which way to go.

faqs.q: How do I know if my drapes need dry cleaning?
faqs.a: Lined silk, loose older weaves, and fabrics that water-spot need the dry cleaning route. We check the fabric and tell you before anything is taken down. Many drapes can be cleaned where they hang instead.

faqs.q: Do you rehang the drapes?
faqs.a: Yes. We note how each panel hangs when we take it down and rehang everything the same way when it comes back. You do not touch a ladder.

faqs.q: How long are the drapes gone?
faqs.a: Usually less than a week from pickup to rehanging. We tell you the expected day when we pick them up.

mattress-cleaning.tagline: Mattress cleaning for Orange County homes.
paragraphs: You spend a third of your life on the mattress, and it collects sweat, skin, dust, and the occasional spill the whole time. We clean mattresses with hot-water extraction: hot water and cleaning solution go in, and the soil comes back out to the truck.

The most common calls are a child's accident, a pet that got on the bed, and a mattress that smells stale. All three respond to extraction because the problem is in the top layers, which is what the machine reaches and rinses.
We clean the sleeping surface and the sides, treat spots and odors, and leave the mattress damp to the touch, not wet. It is ready to sleep on the same night with normal airflow in the room.
A stain that soaked deep into the core years ago may shadow even after cleaning. We look first and tell you what will lift before we start, and you get the price up front.
A mattress cleaning pairs well with carpet or upholstery on the same visit. Call (949) 992-3299 and tell us the size and what happened to it.

faqs.q: How long until I can sleep on the mattress?
faqs.a: The same night. We extract most of the moisture as we clean, so the mattress is damp, not wet. Leave the bedding off and the room airing for the afternoon.

faqs.q: Can you get urine out of a mattress?
faqs.a: Fresh accidents usually clean up well because they sit in the top layers. An old stain that reached the core can leave a shadow, and we tell you that before we start.

faqs.q: How much does mattress cleaning cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size and the condition. Call (949) 992-3299 with the size and what happened, and we will give you a price range on the phone and the exact price on-site before we start.

yacht-cleaning.tagline: Boat and yacht interior cleaning in Orange County harbors.
paragraphs: A boat cabin collects the same soil as a living room, plus salt air and damp. We clean the carpet, the upholstered seating, the mattresses in the berths, and the curtains on board, at the dock.

Marine interiors hold moisture, so the method matters. We use low-moisture cleaning where the cabin needs it and extraction where the fabric allows it, so the cabin dries instead of staying damp under the waterline vents.

We have cleaned boats at Newport Beach, Dana Point, and Huntington Harbour slips. Tell us the marina and the slip, and we bring the equipment down the dock. Curtains are cleaned where they hang, the same as in a house.

A musty cabin smell usually lives in the soft surfaces: the V-berth cushions, the carpet, the curtains. Cleaning those is what moves the needle. We tell you honestly if what you have is a mildew problem that cleaning alone will not fix.
We walk the boat with you and give the price before we start. Call (949) 992-3299 with the boat size and the marina, and we will tell you the next opening.

faqs.q: Do you come to the marina?
faqs.a: Yes. We clean at the slip. Tell us the marina, the dock, and the slip number, and we bring the equipment to the boat at Newport Beach, Dana Point, Huntington Harbour, and the rest of Orange County.

faqs.q: Can you get the musty smell out of the cabin?
faqs.a: If the smell lives in the cushions, carpet, and curtains, cleaning them makes a real difference. If there is active mildew behind panels, we tell you that cleaning alone will not fix it.

faqs.q: How long does the cabin take to dry?
faqs.a: We use low-moisture methods where the cabin needs them, so most interiors are dry the same day with the hatches open. We tell you the drying time before we start.

rv-cleaning.tagline: RV and motorhome interior cleaning in Orange County.
paragraphs: An RV is a house that drives, and the carpet in it works harder than the carpet in a house: sand from campsites, grease from the cockpit step, food in the dinette, and pets everywhere. We clean the carpet, the seats, the dinette cushions, and the mattress over the cab.
We clean the RV where it is parked: your driveway, the storage lot, or the campground if the hoses reach. The truck stays outside and the hoses run in through the door, the same way we clean a house.
Captain's chairs and dinette fabric get upholstery extraction. Carpet gets hot-water extraction. The over-cab mattress, which traps dust and sun heat, cleans up the same way a bedroom mattress does.

RVs that sat closed for a season come out stale. Cleaning the soft surfaces, which is where the smell lives, is the right first step, and we tell you honestly if a smell is coming from a tank or a leak instead of the fabric.
We walk the rig with you and give the price before we start, based on what is inside, not a flat guess. Call (949) 992-3299 with the length and where it is parked.

faqs.q: Where do you clean the RV?
faqs.a: Where it is parked: your driveway, a storage lot, or a campground if the hoses reach. Tell us where it sits and we will tell you if the truck can work there.

faqs.q: Can you clean the over-cab mattress and the dinette?
faqs.a: Yes. The mattress, the dinette cushions, and the captain's chairs all get cleaned along with the carpet. We quote the whole interior before we start.

faqs.q: The RV smells stale after storage. Will cleaning fix it?
faqs.a: If the smell lives in the carpet, cushions, and mattress, yes, that is where it usually is. If it is coming from a tank or a leak, we tell you that honestly instead of selling you a cleaning.
